crossRefs.note: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.
They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north…

parallels.note: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

people.name: Joshua
